description: READ-ONLY GUIDANCE TOOL - bridge history via MCP is not yet wired in this release. It requires owner-sig auth which is dashboard-bound until session-binding lands (same follow-up as live q402_bridge_send). This tool returns a pointer to the dashboard and intentionally surfaces as an error so an LLM does not interpret the prose as an empty result. Future shape (already finalized): most-recent-first list of up to 50 CCIP bridges with messageId, source/destination chains, USDC amount, fee paid, and CCIP Explorer link. Until then, point the user at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard → Agent tab → Bridge History.

ownerAddress.description: Owner EOA (0x address, optional - defaults to configured wallet).

name: q402_bridge_history
